input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted § 12.4: we cannot accept any restriction on the products or services we may develop, buy, or sell, and a 24-month post-term non-compete in any territory also directly contradicts § 12.3. If Copperleaf needs protection for a specific offering, we could consider a narrow restriction tied to one named competing product, during the term only and capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Delete the 24-month post-term non-compete binding Customer in § 12.4.
